column2: (4) The Authority may by regulation specify—
the conditions applicable to access to any area which
falls within an Area declared in terms of section 26.
Such regulations shall not however apply in  respect
of  public  roads,  public  monuments,  places  of
worship,  public  parks,  public  offices,  schools,
dispensaries and other public places and facilities
provided  by  either  the  government,  a  Provincial
Council or a local authority, which were  in existence
at the time of the promulgation of such regulation ;
